No, that is not true.

In Switzerland, the general speed limit on motorways (autostradas) is **120 km/h**, not 130 km/h as in Germany.

Key points:

- **Swiss motorway speed limit**: 120 km/h
- **German Autobahn speed limit**: Typically 130 km/h (though some sections have lower limits, and there is no general legal maximum speed limit on unrestricted sections)

Switzerland maintains a consistently lower maximum speed limit on its highways compared to Germany, and it is strictly enforced. So, if you are driving in Switzerland, you should adhere to the 120 km/h limit on motorways.
